body: Landed 149b38d (all MAME runs through one helper). For VectorCraft: gitleaks exits 0 when its git log fails, so a doubled space in --log-opts made every push pass; we also refuse when gitleaks logs an error and scan merge resolutions (--diff-merges=separate). Landing next: the ede6743 port, the 50% rule, gitleaks, start-page progress (Robotron 64%). Lessons: better placement exposed a shot-timing gap in a verified replay (fix the model, never the replay); an agent amended after review. Proposed: hooks flag orphan reviews. Shared: shared code is copied for now and a shared repo comes later; Sinistar's voice will be menacing.
summary: Check-in: mame_process landed; a gitleaks fail-open fix for VectorCraft; a proposal to catch commits amended after review
